name: Polymer Properties & Engineering Polymers
summary: Covers the thermal, mechanical, viscoelastic and rheological behaviour of polymers and how to choose and design with them.

topics.name: Thermal transitions: glass transition and melting; factors that control Tg and Tm
Polymer solutions and blends: Flory-Huggins theory and miscibility
Stress-strain behaviour of glassy, semicrystalline and rubbery polymers
Viscoelasticity: creep, stress relaxation, Maxwell and Kelvin-Voigt models
Dynamic mechanical behaviour: storage and loss moduli
Time-temperature superposition and the WLF equation
Rubber elasticity: entropy springs, cross-link density and vulcanisation
Yielding, crazing and shear banding; fracture and toughening of polymers
Melt rheology: shear thinning, viscosity models and die swell
High-performance polymers and fibres: aramid (Kevlar), UHMWPE (Dyneema), PBO, PEEK, polyimides
Thermoset resins: epoxy, cyanate ester, phenolic and bismaleimide curing chemistry
Designing plastic parts: creep allowances, temperature limits and safety factors
